ux_contract: One sample Company-scoped story links Person, Employment, OrgUnit, change Approval and monthly PayrollRun. Every record has stable normal route; lists lead to object pages rather than JSON APIs.
Work starts with actionable requests and exceptions, their owners/deadlines and progress. People supports search/list -> person detail -> employment; no blank form as primary landing.

Employment object shows employer, engagement, dates, current assignment, pending change, before/after, evidence and history. Change form opens prefilled from record; local preview comparison renders entered values without claiming save/submission.
Organization shows readable hierarchy and selected-unit facts/people, effective context and link to same pending reassignment.

Approvals has inbox/outbox and selected decision page with subject, Company, exact difference, evidence, chronology, owner and explicit consequence. Preview decision control opens consequence explanation; no simulated approved outcome.

Payroll shows Company/period/revision/owner, ordered preparation-review-publication progress, roster, exact sample totals, actionable exceptions linking the same Person/Employment/Approval, and separate export/reconciliation meaning.

Five navigation groups Work/People/Communications/Data/Administration. Only built destinations are active links. Non-MVP destinations may be labeled in preview as unavailable with no false route. Payroll and approvals immediately discoverable.

Desktop evidence beside decision; narrow layout stacks both with anchors. One complete light theme, Korean readable text, accessible labels/headings/focus, no decorative KPI walls, primary action only one per decision.
